raw_response:
This plot is small, only a small piece by the house, but maize is what we eat so I must do my best. I have no schooling and I do what my mother did and what my neighbors do — if the coupon comes from the government I will use the fertilizer, if not I cannot buy a whole bag with my own money. Last year I got one coupon so I put a little NPK at planting and some urea when the maize was at my knee, and I will try the same this year. I put the manure from my goats on this plot because it is near the house, and I weed myself with my children.
